article.headline: Kagiso Rabada storms Centurion as Proteas host Bangladesh in second Test match
article.summary: South Africa and Bangladesh clash in the second Test at SuperSport Park in Centurion, with the Proteas looking to secure a 2-0 series victory.
article.body:
Kagiso Rabada enters this match as a dominant force at his most successful home ground, boasting 59 wickets at an impressive average of 17.96 and a strike rate of 31.5. His performance at this venue remains a primary threat to the visiting side as the series moves to Centurion following the first Test in Johannesburg.

This match holds significant weight for the series outcome, as South Africa looks to close out a 2-0 victory against a competitive Bangladesh squad. Although Bangladesh posted a respectable 400-run first innings total in the previous Test, highlighted by centuries from Towhid Hridoy and Litton Das, South Africa remains the statistical favorite. The hosts maintain a commanding record at SuperSport Park, having secured 24 wins across 30 previous Test matches played at the venue.

According to Cricbuzz, both teams face roster adjustments due to injury. South Africa will be without captain Temba Bavuma, with Aiden Markram stepping in to lead the side. Bangladesh is similarly depleted, missing high-capped veteran Mushfiqur Rahim and primary strike bowler Hasan Mahmud. Despite these absences, South Africa bolsters its bowling attack with the return of Anrich Nortjé, adding further pressure on the Bangladeshi batting lineup. 

Markram brings prior leadership experience to the role, having captained South Africa to two Test victories over Bangladesh during their October 2024 series in Dhaka and Chattogram. The match is scheduled to begin on Monday at SuperSport Park, where the Proteas aim to maintain their historical dominance.

article.headline: Seven South African provinces under thunderstorm warning as heavy downpours hit KwaZulu-Natal
article.summary: Disaster management teams in KwaZulu-Natal are on high alert Sunday following a yellow level 4 weather warning for damaging winds and heavy rain.
article.body:
Residents across seven provinces face a thunderstorm warning this Sunday, while the KwaZulu-Natal Department of Cooperative Governance and Traditional Affairs has placed disaster management teams on high alert. The region is bracing for the continuation of heavy downpours, damaging winds, hail, and severe lightning throughout the day.

This level 4 warning specifically targets the northern and central parts of KwaZulu-Natal. The intensity of the forecasted weather conditions poses a significant risk to the safety of residents, particularly those located in low-lying areas and informal settlements. Officials are highlighting the potential for widespread damage as these weather patterns persist.

According to Cooperative Governance spokesperson Siboniso Mngadi, community members must adhere to safety warnings and prioritize finding shelter. MEC for COGTA, Thulasizwe Buthelezi, issued a direct call for vigilance among motorists and residents alike, citing that recent rains have already caused significant devastation in various parts of the province. The South African Weather Service reports that these conditions are expected to remain a threat for the duration of Sunday.

The alert remains active as authorities monitor the impact of the storm systems across the province. With disaster management teams deployed and on standby, officials continue to urge the public to monitor official updates and avoid high-risk environments until the weather stabilizes.

article.headline: Pep Biel seals historic 2-1 Charlotte playoff win over Chicago Fire
article.summary: Charlotte FC secured its first regulation postseason victory in club history by defeating the Chicago Fire 2-1 on Sunday.
article.body:
Pep Biel hammered home a penalty kick in the 11th minute of stoppage time, turning a tense standoff into a landmark result for Charlotte FC. The strike broke a deadlock at SeatGeek Stadium, providing Charlotte with its first regulation-time win in the club's four-year postseason history. The dramatic finish came just moments after goalkeeper Josh Cohen entered the match specifically to defend a potential penalty shootout, only to concede the deciding goal. 

For the fifth-seeded Charlotte side, this result carries significant momentum into the best-of-three series. While the fourth-seeded Fire entered the playoffs with a higher conference standing, the loss hands Charlotte the advantage in the opening round. The victory also highlights Charlotte’s persistent offensive threat, having finished the regular season with 66 total goals. 

Liel Abada opened the scoring for Charlotte three minutes into the second half, heading in an assist from Henry Kessler. The Fire responded in the 68th minute when Robert Lewandowski leveled the score with a header of his own. Despite the efforts of goalkeeper Chris Brady, who recorded two saves, the Fire defense could not withstand the late pressure. Charlotte goalkeeper Kristijan Kahlina anchored the defensive effort by stopping four shots throughout the match. 

The two clubs will face each other again this Saturday for the second match of the series. The Fire are set to travel to Charlotte as they attempt to stay alive in the best-of-three matchup.

article.headline: Magnitude 5.0 earthquake rattles California central coast near Pinnacles National Park
article.summary: A 5.0 magnitude earthquake struck near Pinnacles National Park late Thursday, marking California's second-strongest seismic event of the year.
article.body:
The 5.0 magnitude quake was part of a broader swarm of 81 smaller tremors recorded in the immediate vicinity of the national park. The epicenter was located north of the park, approximately 12.5 miles from Soledad and 13.5 miles from Gonzales, according to reports from Monterey County Weekly and The Mercury News. Ground movement from the event was felt as far west as the Monterey Peninsula. The earthquake is categorized as the second-strongest tremor to hit California so far this year.

For residents and local officials, the incident serves as a reminder of the region's active seismic nature. Despite the intensity felt in San Benito and South Monterey County, CalFire San Benito-Monterey spokesperson Josh Silvera confirmed that no calls for service were received. There have been no reported injuries or damage following the tremor, which occurred just before 11:00 p.m. on November 19.

Geological data from the U.S. Geological Survey indicates that while the main shock has passed, the area remains under watch for continued seismic activity. Experts currently estimate a 64-percent probability of aftershocks reaching a magnitude above 3.0 within the next seven days. Conversely, the likelihood of a subsequent earthquake exceeding a 5.0 magnitude remains very low, calculated at less than 1 percent. While the park is noted for its volcanic spires and canyons, operations at the national park remained largely unconfirmed by officials following the event.

As of the latest updates, there are no further alerts regarding the structural integrity of the area near the epicenter. Residents in the affected regions are encouraged to monitor USGS forecast updates throughout the upcoming week.

article.headline: Diego Simeone Makes History as Atletico Madrid Routs Getafe 3-0 Away
article.summary: Atlético Madrid secured their fifth consecutive away victory on Sunday by defeating Getafe with goals from Baena, Cardoso, and Grimaldo.
article.body:
Atlético Madrid reached a historic milestone this Sunday, as manager Diego Simeone surpassed Luis Aragonés to become the coach with the most all-time LaLiga wins. The 3-0 result against Getafe CF marked Simeone's 345th victory in the competition’s 97-year history, cementing a dominant road performance that saw the team claim its sixth away win in seven attempts this season. By November, the team has already matched the total number of away wins achieved during the entirety of the previous campaign.

This trend signals a major shift in mentality for the squad, which had struggled with cagey, uninspiring displays on the road last year. The victory provides a clear reaction to earlier setbacks, proving that the current roster is capable of playing on the front foot with 20 total shots throughout the match. For supporters, the change from the tentative build-up play observed last season to this season's aggressive style marks a significant improvement in the team's ability to secure points away from home.

Álex Baena opened the scoring in the 9th minute with a strike from outside the box. Johnny Cardoso extended the lead in the 30th minute following a goalkeeping error by David Soria. Late in the match, a VAR review confirmed a penalty after Djené Dakonam fouled Alexander Sørloth, resulting in a red card for the Getafe defender. Alejandro Grimaldo converted the spot-kick to finish the scoring, marking his fifth goal of the season and securing the win for Los Rojiblancos.

article.body: The shaking traveled as far as Thousand Oaks to the northwest and Long Beach to the southeast, marking the fourth earthquake to hit the region in just four days. According to the U.S. Geological Survey, the tremor registered a 3 on the Modified Mercalli Intensity Scale, described as weak but noticeably felt by those indoors. Residents in Venice reported a short but significant single jolt, while those in Sawtelle experienced enough vibration to rattle light fixtures. The quake’s epicenter was situated approximately two miles from El Segundo and three miles from Manhattan Beach at a depth of 6.2 miles. This seismic event follows a series of recent activity in the area, including a magnitude 3.9 earthquake on Friday and a magnitude 3.3 tremor near San Pedro on Saturday morning. Experts at the USGS have categorized the intensity as weak, noting that no damage is expected from this particular event. While Saturday's activity occurred near the Palos Verdes fault zone, which stretches 70 miles along the coast, the current incident remains under observation. The region has seen multiple seismic movements recently, such as a magnitude 5 quake recorded Thursday night near the San Andreas fault in San Benito County. Updates will continue as further data becomes available regarding the stability of the local fault lines and any subsequent seismic reports.

article.headline: Disability Minister Sir Stephen Timms Seeks Fundamental Overhaul of Pip Assessment Process
article.summary: Sir Stephen Timms is set to release a review on Tuesday recommending major reforms to the personal independence payment system in England and Wales.
article.body: Thirteen years after the creation of the personal independence payment, Disability Minister Sir Stephen Timms concluded the current framework is no longer fit for purpose. His review highlights that the system fails to account for marked shifts in the nature of disability, particularly noting substantial growth in claims regarding mental health and neurodiverse conditions. For those with severe or lifelong conditions, the proposed reforms advocate for a fast-track process designed to remove the burden of regular, adversarial reassessments.  This shift aims to replace a system currently viewed as a barrier to daily participation and employment with a more personalized, flexible approach. By streamlining assessments for the most severe cases, the government intends to free up capacity while redirecting claimants without additional care needs toward more appropriate support services.  The forthcoming report, produced in collaboration with disability groups, carers, clinicians, and MPs, arrives following significant political tension surrounding welfare reforms. Previous attempts to cut disability and sickness-related benefit payments by £5bn per year were abandoned in 2025 after more than 130 MPs opposed the measures. While a separate recent review by Alan Milburn proposed scrapping the benefit for those under 25, the Timms report confirms the system will be retained for all age groups.  With the review scheduled for publication this Tuesday, the government now faces the task of determining how to implement these broad recommendations. Prime Minister Andy Burnham is expected to oversee the next steps in what remains a politically sensitive policy area regarding the financial support of disabled people.

article.headline: Cam Skattebo Breaks Backflip Promise During Giants Win Over The Jaguars
article.summary: Running back Cam Skattebo performed a backflip to seal the New York Giants' victory over the Jacksonville Jaguars just days after pledging to stop the celebration.
article.body:
Cam Skattebo chose to ignore his own promise, opting for a signature backflip with just over two minutes remaining in the fourth quarter against the Jacksonville Jaguars. The move followed a crucial five-yard run that secured a first down and cemented the Giants' win, leaving head coach John Harbaugh visibly surprised on the sidelines. Harbaugh later joked with reporters that his running back simply could not help himself, noting that the player's excitement took over during a high-stakes moment in the game.

This decision marks a sharp reversal from earlier in the week when Skattebo publicly stated he was retiring the celebratory maneuver. His initial decision came after witnessing Detroit Lions defensive end Aidan Hutchinson suffer an ACL tear during a post-sack leap. Skattebo had expressed concern about the potential for injury, telling reporters he would avoid the celebration mentally to ensure such an accident would not happen to him, though he had reserved the right to bring it back for potential playoff appearances.

The performance provided a boost for the Giants as they look to maintain their position atop the NFC East following a difficult loss to the Commanders. While Skattebo had a relatively quiet game overall, managing 34 yards on 14 carries and 14 yards on three receptions, his late-game play proved essential to topping the Super Bowl contenders.

Harbaugh indicated he held no significant grudge over the broken promise, largely because Skattebo remained healthy throughout the feat. The team now moves forward with the win, relying on Skattebo's contributions in their ongoing divisional campaign.
